The author also provides a brief comparison between the two, noting DGRW's slightly higher returns due to more tech exposure and VIG's greater safety and diversification.

title: RPM International Thrives in Rate-Cut Driven Construction Rally
summary: RPM International, a specialty chemicals and building materials manufacturer, is experiencing a surge to all-time highs, driven by an anticipated construction rally fueled by interest rate cuts. Despite a slight revenue decline, the company reported record earnings before interest and taxes (EBIT) in Q1 2025, showcasing improved efficiencies across its diverse brand portfolio. The article highlights RPM's strong market position, mixed guidance, and technical analysis suggesting further growth potential, making it a potential buy for investors seeking construction sector exposure.

title: Home Depot to Force Corporate Staff to Work Shifts in Stores
summary: Home Depot plans to require its corporate staff, including senior management and remote workers, to work 8-hour shifts in retail stores each quarter. This initiative aims to help corporate employees understand the challenges faced by in-store associates and improve employee retention amid rising labor activism and a sales slump. The move is considered unusual for the retail sector.

title: Prime San Antonio retail center changes hands
summary: JLL Capital Markets announced the sale of Village at Stone Oak, a 476,371-square-foot retail center in San Antonio, Texas, from SITE Centers to Sterling Organization. The center, a high-performing asset ranking in the top 5% of U.S. shopping centers, boasts an 84% occupancy rate and a diverse tenant mix. Its strategic location in Bexar County and proximity to an affluent community and major attractions make it an attractive investment.

title: Fastenal Ends 3Q with Momentum
summary: Fastenal reported improved sales metrics for September and the third quarter of 2024, indicating a demand uptick in the industrial supply sector. While gross margin continued to slide, the company demonstrated solid cost discipline and management amidst a challenging demand environment. The sales gains suggest July might have been the low-point for industrial demand, pointing towards a potential acceleration period.

title: Home Depot Plans to Make Every Employee, Including Executives, Work in Stores. It's an Absolutely Brilliant Move
summary: Home Depot plans to implement a policy requiring all employees, including executives, to work an eight-hour shift in a store once per quarter. This initiative is lauded as brilliant for providing corporate staff with hands-on experience and a deeper understanding of the core business, improving decision-making, and fostering respect between employees and executives. The author emphasizes the importance of humility from corporate staff during these shifts for the program to be successful and advocates for similar cross-training in other businesses.

title: Home Depot to open Montgomery location, the first big-box home improvement store in town
summary: Home Depot is set to open its first big-box home improvement store in Montgomery, Texas, on October 24. This new location will create 130 jobs in the 3,000-resident city. The opening marks a significant addition to the area's retail landscape.

title: City issues building permit for The Home Depot in Mandarin
summary: The City of Jacksonville has issued a building permit for a new Home Depot store in Mandarin, to be constructed on the former Kmart site at 9600 San Jose Blvd. The $8 million project will be undertaken by Ordner Construction Co. Inc., creating a 132,975-square-foot facility including a large retail space and a garden center. The demolition of the Kmart store, which closed in 2016, was completed in September.

title: XLY: Consumer Discretionary Dashboard For October
summary: This article analyzes the consumer discretionary sector, focusing on fundamental and momentum metrics, and identifies consumer services as the most compelling subsector due to its slight undervaluation and excellent quality score. It provides fast facts on the XLY sector benchmark and lists nine stocks that are cheaper than their peers in October.

title: Deals of the Year: AGCO closes joint venture with technology company Trimble - Atlanta Business Chronicle
summary: AGCO Corp. has finalized a joint venture with Trimble Inc., acquiring an 85% interest in Trimble's Ag assets and technologies. This deal was recognized as a "Deals of the Year" by the Atlanta Business Chronicle. The acquisition aims to expand AGCO's portfolio as an agricultural machinery and equipment manufacturer and distributor.

title: Cohen & Steers and Acadia Realty Trust Acquire Open-Air Shopping Center in Tampa, FL
summary: Cohen & Steers and Acadia Realty Trust have formed a joint venture to acquire The Walk at Highwoods, a 141,000 square foot open-air shopping center in Tampa, Florida. This acquisition aligns with their shared view that open-air shopping centers are well-positioned for a new economic cycle due to robust demand and limited new retail construction, especially within Tampa's high-growth market. The center is fully occupied by national and local retailers and benefits from Tampa's strong economic and population growth.

title: Grainger Tops National Employee Opportunity Ranking
summary: W.W. Grainger Inc., a major industrial distributor, has been ranked as the top provider of employee opportunities among large U.S. companies in the 2024 American Opportunity Index. The company's performance is attributed to its core principles, recognition of its workforce as a competitive advantage, and various development programs. Grainger Chairman and CEO D.G. Macpherson emphasized the company's commitment to providing meaningful career opportunities for every team member.

title: I’m a Former Maintenance Worker—This Is The Only Brand of Cleaner I Need For My Whole House
summary: A former New York City luxury high-rise janitor, Anthony O'Reilly, tested a suite of Ecolab cleaning products for 30 days and found them to outperform other brands while being significantly more affordable. He highlights six specific Ecolab products—Heavy-Duty Citrus Degreaser, Industrial Degreaser, Mold and Mildew Stain Remover, Foaming Tub and Tile Cleaner, Hardwood and Laminate Floor Cleaner, and Fast Action Foaming Degreaser—detailing their effectiveness on various household cleaning challenges, from stubborn grease to mold and hard water stains. O'Reilly concludes that Ecolab is now the only cleaning brand he needs for his entire home.

title: Urban Edge sells Home Depot property in Union for $71 million
summary: Urban Edge Properties has sold a 232,000-square-foot Home Depot property in Union Township, New Jersey, for $71 million as part of a Section 1031 like-kind exchange. The company simultaneously acquired a 382,000-square-foot upscale retail center in Gambrills, Maryland, for $126 million. This move is part of Urban Edge's strategy to acquire high-quality retail assets in core markets and divest noncore properties.

title: 11 Recycled Building Materials Made From Trash
summary: This article highlights 11 innovative building materials created from post-consumer waste, tackling the significant problem of landfill-bound trash. Companies are transforming items like old jeans, fishing nets, glass bottles, and tires into durable, cost-effective, and eco-friendly construction products. From insulation and carpet tiles to countertops and roofing shingles, these recycled materials offer sustainable alternatives for various building needs.

title: Home Depot co-founder, GOP donor Bernie Marcus dead at 95
summary: Bernie Marcus, the co-founder of Home Depot and a prominent Republican donor, has passed away at the age of 95. A self-made billionaire, Marcus co-founded Home Depot in 1978 and later established the Job Creators Network and the Marcus Foundation, which has given over $2 billion to charitable causes. He was also a staunch critic of President Biden's economic policies.

title: How To Earn $500 A Month From Home Depot Stock Ahead Of Q3 Earnings
summary: This article discusses how an investor can earn $500 a month from Home Depot stock through its dividends, ahead of its Q3 earnings report. It details the number of shares and investment required to achieve this monthly income based on Home Depot's current dividend yield. The article also provides analyst expectations for Home Depot's Q3 earnings and revenue.

title: The Home Depot Announces Third Quarter Fiscal 2024 Results; Updates Fiscal 2024 Guidance
summary: The Home Depot reported third-quarter fiscal 2024 sales of $40.2 billion, a 6.6% increase from the prior year, though comparable sales nationally decreased by 1.3%. The company updated its fiscal 2024 guidance, anticipating a total sales increase of approximately 4% and a diluted earnings-per-share decline of about 2%. This performance exceeded expectations despite macroeconomic uncertainty.

title: Home Depot, Live Nation, em espera
summary: US stock index futures saw a slight decline on Tuesday, following a Wall Street rally driven by election results. Investors are now anticipating key inflation data later in the week to gain further insight into the country's economic and monetary policy outlook. This article also highlights top movers on the NYSE and NASDAQ before market open, along with specific company news for Home Depot, Live Nation, and others.

title: Home Depot’s Q3 results top Wall Street as pullback in consumer spending eases a bit
summary: Home Depot's fiscal third-quarter results surpassed Wall Street expectations, despite an ongoing pullback in consumer spending that was less severe than in previous quarters. The company reported a 6.6% increase in revenue to $40.22 billion and raised its full-year revenue outlook, now expecting a rise of about 4%. While sales at stores open at least a year still declined, the drop was less significant than in the second quarter, leading to a rise in Home Depot's shares in premarket trading.

title: Savvy acquisition saves Home Depot from third-quarter revenue decline
summary: Home Depot Inc. reported third-quarter sales exceeding Wall Street expectations and upgraded its full-year guidance, largely due to its acquisition of SRS Distribution. While total sales increased by 6.6% to $40.2 billion, comparable sales dropped 1.3% year-over-year. The acquisition of SRS Distribution for $18.25 billion is projected to add $6.4 billion in full-year sales, offsetting an expected sales decline for Home Depot without the acquisition.

title: Home Depot Raises Outlook on Hurricane-Fueled Demand
summary: Home Depot Inc. (HD) has raised its sales forecast for a key metric, driven by increased demand for home-improvement materials following adverse weather in the latest quarter. Despite high interest rates impacting the housing market, the company's comparable sales decline of 1.3% was better than Wall Street expectations and represented its best quarterly sales performance in nearly two years. This uptick suggests that hurricane-fueled demand is providing a significant boost to Home Depot's business.

title: Home Depot, Live Nation, em espera
summary: US stock index futures saw a slight dip as investors anticipated key inflation data later in the week, following a recent recovery on Wall Street. The article highlights pre-market movers, with Shopify and Amprius Technologies among the top gainers, and several companies, including Home Depot and Live Nation, seeing their stock movements noted based on recent financial updates and analyst actions.

title: Home Depot grows online sales in Q3
summary: The Home Depot reported a 4% year-over-year increase in online sales for its fiscal Q3, which ended October 27, 2024. Nearly half of these web orders were fulfilled through its physical stores, reflecting the company's focus on an interconnected retail experience. Despite slight declines in average order value and customer transactions, the company highlighted the success of annual sales events and ongoing efforts to improve delivery speeds and expand fulfillment capabilities.

title: VCR: Consumer Discretionary Sector Dashboard For November (NYSEARCA:VCR)
summary: This article provides a monthly dashboard for the Consumer Discretionary sector, led by Fred Piard. It assesses the sector's valuation, highlighting the attractiveness of the consumer services subsector due to its quality score. The article also suggests Vanguard Consumer Discretionary Index Fund ETF Shares (VCR) as a suitable long-term alternative to XLY, noting specific stocks that are currently cheaper than their peers.

title: Why Home Depot made an $18.25 billion bet on the pro business
summary: Home Depot's $18.25 billion acquisition of SRS Distribution is an effort to expand its pro business, especially as DIY demand slows. The deal has already boosted Home Depot's sales and is seen as a way to enter new specialty markets and differentiate itself from competitors like Lowe's. This strategic move aims to accelerate Home Depot's growth by catering to professional contractors in the roofing, pool, and landscaping segments.

title: Top IoT Stocks: Why Samsara and Digi Are Thriving in 2025
summary: This article examines why Samsara (IOT) and Digi International (DGII) are poised for continued thriving in the Internet of Things (IoT) market in 2025. Samsara is highlighted for its hypergrowth in fleet management and industrial IoT, driven by strong financial results and AI integration. Digi International is recognized for its leadership in IoT hardware and connectivity solutions, focusing on mission-critical sectors despite current macroeconomic headwinds, with a turnaround in progress.

title: Home Depot Inc. (HD) reports earnings
summary: Home Depot Inc. (HD) reported its Q3 2024 earnings, showing increased net sales of $40.2 billion, largely due to the acquisition of SRS. However, net earnings and diluted earnings per share decreased, primarily impacted by the SRS acquisition. The company also detailed changes in gross profit, expenses, and cash flow, along with a dividend increase and a paused share repurchase program.

title: After Earnings, Is Home Depot Stock a Buy, a Sell, or Fairly Valued?
summary: Morningstar raised its fair value estimate for Home Depot to $292 per share following its Q3 earnings report, driven by stronger professional product demand despite a decline in DIY sales due to high interest rates. However, shares are still considered overvalued at 25 times next year's earnings. The company maintains a "wide moat" rating due to its brand and cost advantage, but faces risks from weak consumer spending and economic downturns.

title: Here's why Dollar Tree and Dollar General stocks have plummeted
summary: Dollar Tree and Dollar General stocks have fallen approximately 50% this year, facing a mix of economic and self-inflicted problems. Lower-income Americans, who constitute a large portion of their customer base, are prioritizing consumables due to high inflation, while middle and upper-middle income shoppers are not trading down to dollar stores because of a strong job market. Additionally, these companies lag in e-commerce capabilities compared to larger retailers and have faced worker safety violations, further contributing to their struggles.

title: Stanley Black & Decker CEO on potential Trump tariffs: Tool prices will go up
summary: Stanley Black & Decker CEO Don Allan believes that new tariffs proposed by Donald Trump could significantly increase the cost of tools, making products up to 60-70% more expensive if manufacturing were moved from China to the U.S. The company has already begun discussing potential pricing actions with customers in anticipation of these changes. Despite tariff concerns, Stanley Black & Decker provided an upbeat long-term outlook, targeting $16.5 billion to $17 billion in sales by fiscal year 2027, although the company's recent performance has been impacted by consumer weakness and a challenging housing market.

title: ‘Everything is on the table’: Williams-Sonoma preps for tariff hikes
summary: Williams-Sonoma is preparing for potential new U.S. tariffs on China imports by evaluating various mitigation options, including reducing sourcing from China and shifting production to other countries. The company has already significantly decreased its reliance on China for goods since 2020. Its vertically integrated supply chain and U.S. manufacturing hubs provide strategic flexibility in responding to changes in the tariff landscape.

title: Holiday crime crackdown: An inside look at Billings police detective sting operations
summary: Billings Police Department detectives conducted a sting operation at Home Depot to combat a seasonal spike in theft. Senior Det. Jeff Chartier noted that the first Wednesday after Thanksgiving is a common period for theft. At least three individuals were arrested, with two found to have illegal drugs and outstanding warrants worth approximately $70,000, underscoring the police's vigilance against retail crime during the holidays.

title: FIFA Welcomes The Home Depot as Official Home Improvement Retailer for FIFA World Cup in 2026 in North America
summary: The Home Depot has been named the Official Home Improvement Retail Supporter for the FIFA World Cup 2026 across North America. This partnership will see The Home Depot offer on-site activations at FIFA Fan Festivals and stadiums in Canada, Mexico, and the U.S., engaging both customers and over 465,000 associates. Both organizations emphasize a commitment to community and inclusivity for the expanded 48-nation tournament.

title: Home Depot accused of faking Black Friday deals by masking original prices with holiday sale stickers showing the same cost
summary: Home Depot is facing accusations of false advertising for its Black Friday sales, after a viral TikTok video showed an item with a "holiday sale" sticker revealing the exact same original price underneath. Retail experts suggest this practice could be considered false advertising and might further erode customer trust, especially given current concerns about shrinkflation. While proving false advertising can be difficult, consumers are likely to feel misled by such tactics, which contribute to the perception that Black Friday deals are not as significant as they once were.

title: What’s new: Amazon Fresh coming to Corona; Murrieta gets another Home Depot
summary: This article highlights new developments in the Inland Empire, including the opening of an Amazon Fresh grocery store in Corona and a second Home Depot in Murrieta, both set for December 12. It also covers the groundbreaking for Southern California Edison's new Edison Training Academy in Corona, the sale of Summit Business Center in Riverside for $19 million, and the opening of a new EV supercharging station at the Lebec Travel Center.

title: Verrado Marketplace, Teravalis: Key Buckeye developments to look for in 2025
summary: Buckeye, Arizona, a rapidly growing city, is set for significant developments in 2025 despite ongoing water supply challenges. Key projects include the Verrado Marketplace, a large shopping center expected to open in early 2026, and Teravalis, a massive master-planned community whose first village, Floreo, will have its grand opening. Additionally, the city is revitalizing its downtown area to attract businesses and improve walkability.

title: Builders FirstSource to acquire Alpine Lumber
summary: Builders FirstSource, Inc. announced its definitive agreement to acquire Alpine Lumber Company, expanding its presence in Colorado and New Mexico. The acquisition, valued at approximately $500 million in trailing twelve months sales, is expected to be accretive to Builders FirstSource's adjusted earnings per share in 2025 and will be financed through existing cash and credit facilities. This move aligns with Builders FirstSource's strategy to invest in high-growth areas and enhance its footprint in the West Division.

title: Home Depot’s $9.5 Million Meal Break Settlement Gets Final Nod
summary: A federal court has approved a $9.5 million settlement involving Home Depot and over 32,000 associate workers. The lawsuit alleged that the company's administrative and staffing policies prevented these employees from taking their legally required full meal and rest breaks between 2018 and 2024. This settlement resolves claims brought against the home improvement retailer.

title: 1 Vanguard Index Fund Could Turn $375 Per Month Into a $569,400 Portfolio That Pays $17,200 in Annual Dividend Income
summary: This article highlights how consistent small investments in the Vanguard High Dividend Yield ETF (VYM) can lead to a substantial retirement portfolio. Investing $375 monthly could result in a nearly $570,000 portfolio yielding over $17,000 in annual dividend income over 30 years. The ETF's low expense ratio, lower volatility compared to the S&P 500, and historical performance are key attractive features for risk-averse investors.

title: The Walmart Effect
summary: New research suggests that Walmart has a broadly negative economic impact on the communities it operates in, challenging the long-held belief that its low prices significantly benefit consumers. Two papers indicate that the costs of lower earnings and higher unemployment outweigh the savings for shoppers, ultimately making communities poorer. The findings also question the consumer-welfare standard used in antitrust regulation, suggesting it overlooks broader economic impacts beyond price.

title: Who Owns Ridgid Tools And Where Are They Made?
summary: This article explains the ownership and manufacturing origins of Ridgid Tools. It details that Ridgid is owned by Emerson Electric since 1966, an American company founded in Elyria, Ohio, which still maintains its headquarters there. While some tool components are made in Pennsylvania, various power tools are manufactured by Hong Kong-based Techtronic Industries (TTI), and Ridgid maintains an exclusive sales relationship with Home Depot.

title: Who Owns Home Depot? Owner, CEO and Key Data (2026)
summary: Home Depot is a public company with shares listed on the New York Stock Exchange, meaning it has no single owner. Its major shareholders include The Vanguard Group and BlackRock, who influence strategic decisions. Edward 'Ted' Decker serves as the Chairman, CEO, and a member of the Board of Directors, focusing on integrating digital and physical channels for an improved customer experience. The company, founded in 1978, has expanded significantly through strategic acquisitions and is recognized for its philanthropy and commitment to sustainability.

title: Home Depot buys former Wells Fargo building
summary: Home Depot has acquired a former Wells Fargo building in Pembroke Park, Florida, as part of its plan to open 80 new stores. This move aligns with the Atlanta-based retailer's strategy to expand its footprint for home repair goods. The announcement comes after Home Depot revealed its expansion intentions earlier in the year.

title: Home Depot Buys Roofing Distributor in Deal Valued at $18 Billion Including Debt
summary: Home Depot announced its acquisition of SRS Distribution for $18 billion, including debt. This strategic move aims to expand Home Depot's reach into supplying professional contractors and large construction projects, diversifying its business beyond traditional do-it-yourself sales, which have been slowing. The acquisition reflects a significant bet on the professional segment of the home improvement market.

title: GLIDDEN paint by PPG names Brick Red Spray Paint Color of the Year 2025
summary: PPG's Glidden paint brand has named Brick Red as its Spray Paint Color of the Year 2025, a complementary color to their 2025 Color of the Year, Purple Basil. This energetic and warm red encourages consumers to use bold colors for accent pieces, reflecting a shift towards warmer shades and curated maximalism. Glidden color experts note that consumers are increasingly selecting colors that bring them joy rather than focusing on resale value.

title: Home Depot orders corporate staff to take 8-hour retail shifts
summary: Home Depot will require all corporate employees, including senior management and remote workers, to complete an eight-hour retail shift each quarter starting in Q4 this year. This move is aimed at connecting corporate staff with the core of the business and understanding the challenges faced by store associates. The decision comes amidst a sales slump, rising labor activism, and efforts to improve store employee retention.

title: 3 Retail Trends for 2024
summary: This article discusses three key retail trends for 2024, highlighting the nuanced differences between consumer discretionary and staples spending, the normalization of retailer inventories, and the resilient albeit segmented growth of e-commerce. It addresses consumer spending contradictions and their impact on retail strategies, noting a potential reduction in discounts and the benefits of a strong e-commerce framework for profitability. The piece also references several ETFs related to these retail sectors.

title: Home Depot announced strong results and improved its outlook
summary: Home Depot reported strong third-quarter results, beating investor expectations and raising its annual forecast, partly due to an $18 billion acquisition and increased demand from hurricane-related repairs and a long summer. The performance offers insights into US consumer confidence, although the boosts from acquisitions and weather may skew the perception of consumer financial health. The article also highlights a valuation gap between Home Depot and Lowe's, with analysts expecting higher growth for Lowe's despite Home Depot's higher current valuation.

title: Home Depot Lifts Full-Year Outlook After Third-Quarter Sales Rise
summary: Home Depot raised its full-year guidance after exceeding third-quarter sales expectations. The company reported adjusted earnings of $3.78 per share, surpassing analyst forecasts of $3.65 per share, with revenue climbing 6.6% to $40.22 billion. Comparable-store sales declined less than anticipated, indicating stronger performance driven by customer purchases of outdoor products and hurricane preparedness items.

title: Home Depot's sales continue to soften in 2024 as inflation, delayed start to spring weigh on sales
summary: Home Depot's sales continued to soften in the first quarter of 2024 due to high mortgage rates, inflation, and a delayed start to spring. The home improvement retailer saw sales slip 2.3% and customer transactions dip, marking the third consecutive quarter of declines after a pandemic-era surge. Despite challenges in the consumer market, Home Depot is focusing on its professional business segment, including a recent "$18.25 billion" acquisition of SRS Distribution.

title: Carlisle Companies Announces that Henry, a Carlisle Company, is Recognized as The Home Depot’s Building Materials Partner of the Year for the Second Time in Three Years
summary: Carlisle Companies announced that its Henry brand has been recognized as The Home Depot’s Building Materials Partner of the Year for 2024, marking the second time in three years it has received this award. This award acknowledges Henry's outstanding performance, product innovation, and its seamless integration into Carlisle's operations. The recognition highlights Henry's contributions to Carlisle's Vision 2030 strategy and its collaboration with The Home Depot on new product developments.

title: GLIDDEN Paint by PPG picks 2025 Color of the Year: Purple Basil
summary: GLIDDEN Paint by PPG has announced Purple Basil (PPG1046-7) as its 2025 Color of the Year, a warm, high-impact hue designed to encourage consumers to embrace dramatic colors in their homes. Glidden's color experts recommend Purple Basil for interior walls, trim, cabinetry, and exterior accents, suggesting it for both professional and DIY designers. This choice reflects a growing appreciation for self-discovery and self-expression, aligning with the rise of maximalism in design.

title: T.J. Maxx parent company opening 1,300 new locations in sizable expansion
summary: TJX, the parent company of T.J. Maxx, Marshalls, HomeGoods, and Sierra, announced plans for a significant global expansion, intending to open 1,300 new stores across the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Australia. This expansion would increase its total footprint by over 26% to more than 6,200 locations. The company reported a 3% increase in comparable sales in the most recent quarter and is also remodeling 480 existing locations to maintain store quality and competitiveness.

title: Stanley Black & Decker Recalls DeWALT Battery Walk-Behind Mowers Due to Laceration Hazard | CPSC.gov
summary: Stanley Black & Decker has recalled approximately 46,200 DeWALT Battery Walk-Behind Mowers due to a laceration hazard. If water enters the handle support while the battery is installed, the mower may fail to shut off or start unexpectedly. Consumers are advised to stop using affected mowers if they have gotten wet and contact DeWALT for a free repair.

title: Trex Company Welcomes New Chief Information Officer to Leadership Team
summary: Trex Company, Inc. announced that Dr. Anand Kangala has joined as its new Vice President and Chief Information Officer, effective immediately. Dr. Kangala will lead global IT functions and enterprise technology strategy, focusing on digital solutions and data-driven decision-making. His experience includes leadership roles at Home Depot, Edward Jones, Carter's Inc., Cato Corporation, and IBM.

title: Investment bank Jefferies’ profit more than triples: CEO says the ‘cherry on top’ is that ‘financial stars are aligning’ after crippling inflation
summary: Jefferies Financial Group reported exceptionally strong performance in 2024, with net revenues reaching $7.03 billion and fourth-quarter profits more than tripling. The company increased its quarterly dividend and attributed its success to market share gains, improved market conditions, and significant growth across all business lines, positioning it as the world's 6th largest investment bank. CEO Richard Handler and President Brian Friedman expressed optimism for 2025, noting the firm is in its best position in its 62-year history.

title: B.C. court authorizes class action against Home Depot over sharing of customer data with Meta
summary: The B.C. Supreme Court has certified a class action lawsuit against Home Depot over the alleged sharing of customer email addresses and purchase details with Meta Platforms, Inc. The plaintiff, Lasse Hvitved, argues that customers had a reasonable expectation of privacy, which Home Depot violated by using an offline conversions tool service with Meta. While the court allowed the privacy breach claims, it struck down causes of action related to contract and unjust enrichment.

title: Nation's fastest-growing city to add another major retailer
summary: Home Depot is opening a new 105,000-square-foot store in Celina, Texas, America's fastest-growing city, following approval of a $1.39 million sales tax grant. The investment is expected to boost the local economy, create jobs, and support infrastructure, as Celina's population continues to rapidly expand with other major retailers like Costco and Lowe's also establishing a presence. This development reflects Celina's significant growth and its appeal to businesses due to new infrastructure, schools, and housing projects.

title: The Home Depot adds two new online delivery partners
summary: The Home Depot is expanding its online delivery options by partnering with DoorDash and Uber Eats. These new collaborations will allow customers to order Home Depot products for on-demand or scheduled delivery, complementing existing partnerships with Instacart and Walmart's GoLocal service. The initiative is aimed at providing greater flexibility and convenience for both DIY customers and professionals.

title: The Home Depot, Inc. (NYSE:HD) is a favorite amongst institutional investors who own 72%
summary: Institutional investors own 72% of The Home Depot, Inc. (NYSE:HD), indicating their significant influence on the company's stock price and decisions. The Vanguard Group, Inc. is the largest shareholder, holding 9.6% of outstanding shares, while insiders own less than 1% but represent a substantial monetary value. The general public holds a 28% stake, suggesting widely disseminated shares without a single dominant shareholder.

title: Duopoly Discount: Lowe's Is A Better Deal Than Home Depot For DCA Investors (NYSE:LOW)
summary: Lowe's expects a decline in comparable sales for fiscal 2024 due to reduced discretionary DIY spending. Despite short-term challenges, Lowe's has a strong long-term outlook driven by factors like aging homes and remote work trends. For dollar-cost averaging investors, Lowe's is presented as a better value than Home Depot due to a lower growth premium embedded in its stock price, despite similar long-term growth drivers for both companies.

title: Coca-Cola, Home Depot, Walmart To Announce Dividend Increases In Second Half Of February
summary: This article predicts upcoming dividend increases for 10 long-term dividend growth companies in the latter half of February. Notable companies expected to announce increases include Coca-Cola (for its 63rd consecutive year), Walmart, and Home Depot. The author, an individual investor focused on dividend growth stocks, details their investment strategy and disclosures.

title: Class I Briefs: NS, BNSF
summary: Norfolk Southern (NS) has been named to FORTUNE Magazine's list of World's Most Admired Companies for 2025, ranking as the highest railroad in its category. Separately, BNSF received The Home Depot Rail Carrier of the Year award for 2025, recognizing its commitment to service and a pilot project that improved routing and transit time. BNSF also celebrated its Stockton, California team completing a full year without a single injury, an achievement mirrored across other major terminals in the region.

title: Kontoor Brands to buy Helly Hansen from Canadian Tire Corporation
summary: Kontoor Brands, the company behind Wrangler and Lee, is set to acquire the Canadian outdoor workwear brand Helly Hansen from Canadian Tire Corporation. This strategic acquisition aligns with Kontoor Brands' global expansion plans and follows a strong financial performance in the previous quarter. The transaction is expected to be finalized in the second quarter of the current year, pending regulatory approvals.

title: Prologis CEO Hamid Moghadam to retire next year
summary: Hamid Moghadam, co-founder and CEO of Prologis, plans to retire on January 1, 2026, after more than four decades with the company and its predecessor. Dan Letter, current president, will succeed him as CEO, while Moghadam will transition to executive chairman. This succession plan has been in the works for over two years, with Letter having joined AMB in 2004 and becoming president of Prologis in January 2023.

title: Saham The Home Depot, Inc. (HD): Prospek dan Analisis 2025
summary: Artikel ini membahas prospek dan analisis saham The Home Depot, Inc. (HD) untuk tahun 2025, menyoroti posisi perusahaan sebagai ritel perbaikan rumah terbesar di AS. Analisis mencakup data historis pergerakan harga saham, laporan keuangan terkini dengan pendapatan dan laba yang kuat, serta proyeksi masa depan dan tips investasi bagi pemula, termasuk potensi dan risiko. Home Depot dianggap menarik bagi investor karena pertumbuhan stabil, strategi bisnis solid, dan kebijakan dividen yang konsisten.

title: Earnings call transcript: Floor & Decor Q4 2024 beats estimates, stock surges
summary: Floor & Decor Holdings Inc. (FND) reported strong Q4 2024 results, surpassing analyst expectations with an EPS of $0.44 and revenue of $1.11 billion, leading to a 10.94% stock surge in aftermarket trading. The company plans to open 25 new stores in fiscal 2025 and projects sales growth of 6.5% to 10%, maintaining stable gross margins despite facing a cyclical downturn in the flooring industry. Executives highlighted market share gains, supply chain diversification, and increased investments in new stores, technology, and customer service.

title: Going Into Earnings, Is Home Depot Stock a Buy, a Sell, or Fairly Valued?
summary: Morningstar maintains a fair value estimate of $292 per share for Home Depot (HD), viewing the stock as overvalued going into its Q4 earnings report. The analysis highlights an expected sales decline when accounting for an extra week and acquired sales, with focus shifting to professional demand as DIY customers pause big-ticket projects due to high interest rates. While tariffs pose a wild card, Home Depot's scale is expected to help absorb incremental costs, and its wide economic moat provides a competitive edge despite current market challenges.

title: Nvidia, Home Depot, Lowe's, TJX and Salesforce are part of Zacks Earnings Preview
summary: Zacks.com previews upcoming earnings reports from major companies including Nvidia, Home Depot, Lowe's, TJX Companies, and Salesforce. The report highlights the challenging environment for home improvement retailers due to elevated mortgage rates and discusses Nvidia's critical role in AI-focused buildouts, despite recent sentiment shifts. It also provides an overview of the Q4 earnings season scorecard for the Retail sector and the S&P 500.

title: The Home Depot Announces Fourth Quarter and Fiscal 2024 Results; Increases Quarterly Dividend by 2.2%; Provides Fiscal 2025 Guidance
summary: The Home Depot reported strong fourth quarter and fiscal 2024 results, with sales exceeding expectations and a 2.2% increase in its quarterly dividend. The company also provided its fiscal 2025 guidance, forecasting modest sales and comparable sales growth. Despite ongoing macroeconomic pressures, the retailer emphasized continued investments in strategic initiatives.

title: Home Depot, Sempra Energy, American Tower to report earnings Tuesday By Investing.com
summary: Investing.com reports that a diverse group of companies, including Home Depot, Sempra Energy, and American Tower, are scheduled to release their earnings on Tuesday. The article provides a detailed list of companies reporting both before and after market close, along with their estimated EPS and revenue figures. This information offers investors key insights into various economic sectors.

title: The Home Depot Announces Fourth Quarter and Fiscal 2024 Results; Increases Quarterly Dividend By 2.2%; Provides Fiscal 2025 Guidance
summary: The Home Depot announced its fourth quarter and fiscal year 2024 results, reporting an increase in quarterly sales and diluted earnings per share for Q4, despite a decrease in comparable sales for the full fiscal year. The company also declared a 2.2% increase in its quarterly dividend to $2.30 per share and provided its fiscal 2025 guidance, projecting total sales growth of approximately 2.8% and a slight decline in diluted earnings per share. These results exceeded expectations due to greater engagement in home improvement, even amidst a challenging macroeconomic environment.

title: Home Depot Lifts Annual Dividend After Strong Q4, But Soft 2025 Outlook Weighs On Stock
summary: Home Depot (NYSE: HD) reported strong fourth-quarter 2024 results, exceeding revenue and EPS estimates, and announced a 2.2% increase in its quarterly dividend. However, the stock is experiencing volatility due to a softer-than-expected 2025 outlook, with projected declines in adjusted EPS and slightly lower sales growth than anticipated. Despite the positive Q4 performance, the cautious forecast for the upcoming fiscal year is weighing on investor sentiment.

title: Ninja Disrupts the Outdoor Grilling Market with Launch of FlexFlame™
summary: SharkNinja (NYSE: SN) has launched the Ninja™ FlexFlame™, an innovative outdoor cooking system. This revolutionary propane-powered device combines five cooking methods—grilling, smoking, roasting, griddling, and pizza-making—into a single unit, designed to simplify outdoor cooking and deliver high-quality results. The FlexFlame™ utilizes Ninja’s CyclonicHeat-iQ™ technology, integrating rapid convection airflow, precision propane flame control, and Woodfire Technology to enhance its performance.

title: Home Depot says consumers postponing renovation projects, citing high interest rates
summary: Home Depot executives report that consumers are postponing large renovation projects due to high interest rates and uncertain macroeconomic conditions. This has led to a decline in demand for major home improvement projects, with customers increasingly resorting to financing options for those they do undertake. The housing market is also impacted by high mortgage rates and a "golden handcuff" effect, where homeowners with low rates are reluctant to sell, leading to limited supply and dampening pending home sales.

title: Top Stock Movers Now: Sempra, Zoom, Home Depot, and More
summary: U.S. equities declined midday due to a drop in consumer confidence. Sempra (SRE) shares fell after missing estimates and cutting its outlook, while Zoom Communications (ZM) also slumped due to weak guidance. Home Depot (HD) and Solventum (SOLV) saw gains, with Home Depot benefiting from hurricane-related demand and Solventum from selling a business unit.

title: Lowe’s earnings, sales top estimates amid ‘challenging’ home improvement market
summary: Lowe's reported better-than-expected fourth-quarter earnings and sales, including its first same-store sales increase in two years, despite a challenging home improvement market. The company saw net income rise to $1.13 billion and comparable sales edge up 0.2%, driven by Pro customers and online sales. However, Lowe's issued weaker-than-expected full-year guidance for 2025 due to continued high borrowing rates impacting discretionary spending.

title: Lowe's forecasts muted 2025 profit on economic uncertainty, cautious spending
summary: Lowe's (LOW.N) has predicted subdued sales and profits for 2025, mirroring rival Home Depot's outlook, as the home improvement sector faces a downturn due to high interest rates and cautious consumer spending. The retailer expects comparable sales to be flat to up 1% and earnings per share between $12.15 and $12.40, both below analyst estimates. Despite the conservative forecast, driven by economic uncertainty and potential tariff impacts, Lowe's shares rose about 3% following a surprise rise in same-store sales due to hurricane-related demand.

title: Ecolab Celebrates Two-Year Anniversary of Partnership with Home Depot and the Launch of the Ecolab® Scientific Clean™ Product Line
summary: Ecolab is celebrating the two-year anniversary of its partnership with The Home Depot and the successful expansion of its Ecolab® Scientific Clean™ product line. The collaboration began in February 2023, making professional-grade cleaning solutions available to commercial, industrial, and residential customers. Ecolab plans to launch new products and expand its market presence throughout North America in 2025, reinforcing its commitment to innovation and customer needs.

title: Home Depot plans to open new Valley store in Surprise
summary: Home Depot announced its plan to open a new store in Surprise, Arizona, as part of its expansion across the country, which includes over a dozen new locations this year. This new West Valley location will mark another addition to the region's growing retail landscape.

title: After 6-year renovation, Nora Plaza unveils new restaurants, modern look on far north side
summary: Nora Plaza has completed a six-year, modernizing renovation by Kite Realty Group, bringing new restaurants like Culinary Dropout and Flower Child to the Indianapolis food scene. While some original tenants moved, the overhaul is contributing to local growth and attracting new businesses, with further developments such as The Milkshake Factory and Potbelly planned. The transformation has been recognized by local community groups and officials as a significant improvement for the far north side neighborhood.

title: Blink Charging Remains Bullish on the EV Supply Equipment Sector
summary: Despite potential changes in government policy regarding electric vehicles, Blink Charging expressed optimism about the continued growth of the EV supply equipment sector. The company's officials noted that state and local efforts, combined with increasing private investment and consumer demand for affordable EV models, are expected to sustain momentum. They also highlighted the increasing use of polycarbonate in charging station enclosures due to its performance benefits over traditional metal.

title: Home Depot Surprise expansion with new location in 2025
summary: Home Depot Inc. is set to open a new 109,651-square-foot store with an attached garden center in Surprise, Arizona, in April 2025. This new location, situated along Loop 303 at 16601 Cactus Road, is part of 13 new stores the company plans to open this year. The retailer acquired the 18-acre site for $8.4 million last year, positioning it next to the Sycamore Farms project.

title: Home Depot's (NYSE:HD) Dividend Will Be Increased To $2.30
summary: Home Depot (NYSE:HD) is set to increase its quarterly dividend to $2.30, resulting in a 2.3% yield, which is above the industry average. The company has a strong track record of consistent dividend growth, with an approximate 17% compound annual growth rate over the last decade. With earnings comfortably covering the dividend and forecasts for continued EPS growth, Home Depot's dividend is considered sustainable and attractive to income investors.

title: Home Depot Gets Workers’ Back Pay Interest Lawsuit Thrown Out
summary: A federal court has dismissed a lawsuit against Home Depot U.S.A. Inc. that alleged the company improperly listed interest for workers’ back pay from a previous case on incorrect tax forms, leading to unlawful withholding. The US District Court for the District of Oregon found that the claim under the federal false-information statute was invalid because it requires a defendant to willfully misrepresent payment amounts, which was not alleged. Additionally, the workers' claim of over-deducted state income tax was also rejected by the court.

title: 6th Circuit Rules Data Breach Claims Not Covered by CGL Policies
summary: The 6th U.S. Circuit Court of Appeals ruled that Home Depot's commercial general liability (CGL) insurance policies do not cover losses from its 2014-2015 data breach due to an explicit electronic data exclusion. The court affirmed that CGL policies are distinct from cyber insurance and do not indemnify costs associated with data breaches, including those for reissued payment cards or lost usage. This decision highlights the critical difference between cyber and general liability coverage for the insurance industry.

title: THE HOME DEPOT NAMES MICHAEL ROWE EVP OF PRO; STEPHANIE SMITH TO BECOME EVP OF HUMAN RESOURCES
summary: The Home Depot announced new executive appointments, naming Michael Rowe as Executive Vice President of Pro and promoting Stephanie Smith to EVP of Human Resources. Rowe will lead the company's strategy to expand its business with professional customers. Smith will succeed Tim Hourigan, who is retiring, and will be responsible for culture, associate engagement, and leadership development for the company's 470,000 associates.

title: Home Depot turns to AI to answer online shoppers’ questions
summary: Home Depot is integrating generative AI into its online platform to enhance the shopping experience by answering product and project questions. This move aims to replicate in-store customer service online, offering features like design ideas and product comparisons, as the company seeks to revive sales amidst shifting consumer spending habits. Home Depot anticipates improved demand as customers adapt to higher interest rates, focusing on professional contractors and leveraging AI for functions like summarizing product reviews.

title: EXEC: VF Corp. Shares Fall Following Investor Day Part 2
summary: VF Corp. shares fell significantly following its "Reinvent to Grow" Part 2 Investor Day in New York City. The company emphasized introducing new brand leaders and outlined strategic objectives for brands like The North Face, Timberland, Dickies, Altra, and Vans, but lacked specific projections which concerned some analysts. Despite reaffirming targets for 10%+ operating margins by Fiscal 2028, investor sentiment was negative, possibly due to concerns about a brewing trade war.

title: Stock Market Today: Dow Sinks 537 Points On Tariff Threats As S&P 500 Corrects; Gold Miners Jump, Meta Triggers Sell Rule (Live Coverage)
summary: The Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 537 points, and the S&P 500 corrected amid new tariff threats from the Trump administration. Gold miners rallied while Home Depot and Meta Platforms experienced sell-offs, with Meta triggering a sell rule. Despite a late attempt by traders to cover short positions, major indexes ended the trading day lower.

title: I tested the Traeger Woodridge Pro, and it's ideal for set-it-and-forget-it smoking
summary: The Traeger Woodridge Pro is a hybrid pellet grill that excels at smoking, offering a "set-it-and-forget-it" experience with an intuitive app. While it provides decent grilling capabilities, particularly for lower-heat cooking, it has limitations regarding high-heat searing due to the lack of direct flames. The grill features a stout build, ample cooking space, and user-friendly design, making it a strong choice for frequent smokers.

title: Survey reveals Georgia's 34 most trustworthy companies. Georgia Power, Coca-Cola make cut
summary: A new survey by Newsweek and Statista identified 34 Georgia-based companies among the 700 most trustworthy in the United States. The survey considered 97,000 evaluations from potential customers, investors, and employees. Notable companies like Georgia Power, Coca-Cola, and The Home Depot are included in the list, spanning various sectors from automotive to financial services.

title: UPS CEO Carol Tomé to deliver 2025 Oglethorpe Commencement address
summary: Oglethorpe University announced that UPS CEO Carol B. Tomé will deliver the 2025 Commencement address on May 3. Tomé, who is the 12th CEO in UPS's history and previously served as CFO of The Home Depot, will also be awarded an honorary doctor of letters degree. The ceremony will be presided over by President Kathryn McClymond and Board of Trustees Chair Tammy Pearson, and will include speeches and awards for graduates.

title: Home Depot Inc. (HD) reports earnings
summary: Home Depot Inc. (HD) has filed its 10-K report for the fiscal year ended February 2, 2025, reporting net sales of $159.5 billion, a 4.5% increase from the previous year, partly due to the acquisition of SRS. The company achieved net earnings of $14.8 billion and increased its quarterly cash dividend by 2.2%. Strategic investments will continue in its supply chain, technology, and customer experience, with approximately $4 billion planned for capital expenditures in fiscal 2025.

title: Byte-Sized AI: Walmart Announces Gen AI Merchant Tool; Oxford Industries Partners With Exotec
summary: Walmart has launched a new generative AI tool called Wally to help its merchants automate tasks, generate insights, and improve decision-making. Simultaneously, Oxford Industries has partnered with Exotec to implement AI-enabled robotics in its new distribution center, aiming to streamline warehouse operations and returns processing. The article also highlights Augment securing $25 million in funding for its AI-powered logistics assistant, Augie, and Lowe's introducing a gen AI chatbot, Mylow, for home improvement assistance.

title: Williams-Sonoma Joins The S&P 500
summary: Williams-Sonoma, Inc. has been added to the S&P 500, a significant milestone for the retailer that acknowledges its brand portfolio and growth strategies. The company's CEO, Laura Alber, stated their commitment to innovation, customer experience, and long-term stakeholder value. This announcement follows a strong fiscal year 2024 finish, with increased net revenue and net earnings in the fourth quarter.

title: JAMES HARDIE ACQUIRING AZEK
summary: James Hardie Industries plc has agreed to acquire The AZEK Company Inc. for $8.75 billion in cash and shares, creating a leading exterior and outdoor living building products growth platform. The acquisition aims to accelerate growth, enhance customer solutions, and drive shareholder value by combining complementary products like siding, exterior trim, decking, and railing. The transaction is expected to close in the second half of calendar year 2025, pending regulatory and AZEK shareholder approvals, and promises significant cost and commercial synergies, targeting over $1 billion in annual free cash flow.

title: Home Depot, world's largest home improvement chain, plans to build its fifth Polk County store
summary: Home Depot is planning to build its fifth store in Polk County, a 135,632-square-foot retail store in Davenport on U.S. 27. The project will include a 28,000-square-foot garden center and will be reviewed by Polk County's Development Review Committee on March 27. This new location will provide jobs and serve the growing Davenport area, which is seeing numerous new housing and commercial developments.

title: News | Intermodal transportation network, population growth convince Home Depot to expand in Edmonton
summary: The Home Depot has expanded its distribution network in Edmonton, Alberta, with a new 206,000-square-foot facility developed by Qualico Properties. This expansion, prompted by Edmonton's intermodal transportation network and population growth, supports Home Depot's 11 stores in the region. The project, completed in two phases for $36.9 million, earned a 2025 CoStar Impact Award for commercial development for Edmonton.

title: Home Depot nears completion on South Hill
summary: Home Depot's new South Hill store, located at 4515 S. Regal in Spokane, is nearing completion with an expected opening in June. The $17.8 million project includes a 108,000-square-foot building and a 26,000-square-foot garden center, creating nearly 200 jobs. This new development comes after a previous plan in 2008 was canceled due to neighborhood objections.

title: Despite environmental concerns, Stockton City Council enters 20-year partnership with Home Depot
summary: The Stockton City Council approved a 20-year partnership with The Home Depot, projecting $500,000 to $1 million in annual revenue for the city. This agreement will facilitate the expansion of Home Depot's e-commerce and distribution operations in a new 600,000 to 700,000 square foot facility at the Port of Stockton, creating 80-100 permanent jobs. Despite environmental concerns raised by the Delta-Sierra Group regarding the health impacts on nearby residents from increased emissions, the council voted 6-1 in favor, with Mayor Christina Fugazi noting the facility is already near completion and the potential revenue is crucial for community reinvestment.

title: XLY ETF Holdings List — AMEX:XLY
summary: This article provides a detailed list of the top holdings for the XLY ETF (State Street Consumer Discretionary Select Sector SPDR ETF) as of February 27, 2026. It includes the weight percentage, number of shares, and market value for each company held within the ETF. Key holdings include Amazon.com, Inc., Tesla, Inc., Home Depot, Inc., and McDonald's Corporation, among others.

title: The Zacks Analyst Blog Highlights Walmart, Costco Wholesale and The Home Depot
summary: The Zacks Analyst Blog highlights blue-chip retail stocks Walmart, Costco Wholesale, and The Home Depot as stable investment options amidst global trade war uncertainties. These companies are noted for their financial strength, market dominance, and adaptability, which allow them to navigate rising tariffs and economic turbulence. The article details each company's strategies, financial performance, and dividend payouts, positioning them as reliable choices for investors seeking stability and sustained growth.

title: Home Depot subsidiary Construction Resources Co. buys stone slab and tile company
summary: The Home Depot subsidiary Construction Resources Co. has acquired Opustone, a stone slab and tile distributor. This acquisition expands the Decatur-based company's luxury design offerings. The deal was reported by the Atlanta Business Chronicle.

title: Hilton Stock Faces Challenges: Insights Unveiled
summary: Hilton Worldwide Holdings Inc. (HLT) stock has dropped by -3.69% due to investor reactions to potential regulatory challenges. Jefferies lowered its price target for Hilton to $228 from $277 but maintained a Hold rating, influencing investor sentiment. Despite robust revenue and a strong gross margin, the company faces pressures on profitability margins and has a leaner liquidity position, alongside significant long-term debt and capital outflows.

title: The Home Depot, Inc. (NYSE:HD) is favoured by institutional owners who hold 73% of the company
summary: Institutional investors hold a significant 73% ownership in The Home Depot, Inc. (NYSE:HD), indicating their strong preference for the company and influence on its stock price. The Vanguard Group, Inc., BlackRock, Inc., and State Street Global Advisors, Inc. are among the largest shareholders, while insiders own less than 1% but have been recently buying shares. The general public accounts for 27% ownership.

title: Home Depot in Buckeye coming up due to recent purchase
summary: Home Depot is moving forward with plans to open a new store in Buckeye, Arizona. The company recently purchased 11.14 acres at the Buckeye Commons shopping center for $7.7 million and applied for a building permit for a 137,347-square-foot store. This development positions Home Depot as another major retailer alongside Costco in the Buckeye Commons center.

title: Lowe’s extends brand into digital gaming
summary: Lowe's has announced a new partnership with EA Sports to integrate its brand into popular digital game titles such as EA Sports FC, Madden NFL, and College Football. This collaboration aims to engage sports fans and new generations of home improvers through in-game branding and a real-life "On the Road" interactive gaming experience. The move is part of Lowe's broader strategy to connect with consumers through their passions, following a similar marketing agreement with Lionel Messi and Inter Miami CF.

title: News | Construction equipment giant calls workers back for a five-day workweek
summary: Caterpillar, the construction equipment giant, is ending its hybrid work policy and will require all U.S. corporate employees to return to the office five days a week starting in June. This decision follows a memo stating that the previous hybrid model yielded "varying results" and emphasizes the importance of in-person collaboration. The move aligns Caterpillar with other major companies that are increasing their return-to-office mandates.

title: St. Augustine Home Depot opening scheduled April 17
summary: The 새로운 Home Depot in St. Augustine, located in World Commerce Center, is set to open on April 17, 2025. A "Neighborhood Night" public event will precede the opening on April 16, featuring games, refreshments, and a traditional board-cutting ceremony. The store, which cost $16.82 million to construct, is expected to create 150 new jobs.

title: DiCello Levitt Files Class Action Against Major Rental Equipment Companies for Anticompetitive Practices
summary: DiCello Levitt has filed a class action lawsuit against several major rental equipment companies, including RB Global, Inc. and United Rentals, Inc., alleging anticompetitive practices and price fixing in the rental equipment market. The lawsuit, brought by Immediate Appliance Service, Inc., claims that the defendants conspired to stabilize rental prices, causing clients to pay supracompetitive prices since March 31, 2021. The case is filed in the United States District Court for the Northern District of Illinois and seeks to represent affected renters.

title: From Lululemon to Birkenstocks, viral videos are urging shoppers to buy direct from China. Should you do it?
summary: Viral TikTok videos are encouraging consumers to buy directly from Chinese factories, claiming to offer major brands like Lululemon and Birkenstock at a fraction of the retail price. While some shoppers are embracing this trend due to economic pressures and tariffs, experts warn that these direct purchases are unlikely to be identical to their brand-name counterparts, primarily due to differences in material quality and potential risks for manufacturers. This phenomenon highlights a shift in consumer values towards cost-conscious behavior and the increasing acceptance of "dupes."

title: Lowe’s makes $1.3 billion acquisition deal to compete with Home Depot
summary: Lowe's Companies announced a $1.3 billion acquisition of Artisan Design Group (ADG) to bolster its competition with Home Depot. This strategic move will expand Lowe's Pro offering into a new distribution channel, targeting the approximately $50 billion interior finishes market for home builders and property managers. The acquisition is expected to close in the second quarter of 2025 and will be financed with cash on hand, allowing Lowe’s to build on its momentum and expand its total addressable market.

title: Trump meeting retailers including Walmart, Home Depot, Target regarding tariff concerns
summary: President Trump is reportedly meeting with major retailers like Target, Walmart, Home Depot, and Lowe's to discuss concerns over his imposed tariffs on imported goods. The discussions, taking place at the White House, will focus on how these tariffs affect their businesses. Walmart's CEO, Doug McMillon, is confirmed to attend, while Home Depot regularly engages with government officials on such issues. Although Lowe's was initially reported to attend, their spokesperson later confirmed they were not in attendance.

title: Home Depot (NYSE:HD) Has A Pretty Healthy Balance Sheet
summary: The article analyzes Home Depot's balance sheet, focusing on its debt levels. It finds that while Home Depot has a substantial amount of debt (US$51.2b), its strong interest coverage and ability to generate free cash flow indicate that it can manage its obligations comfortably. The analysis concludes that the company has a healthy balance sheet, suggesting that its debt is not a significant risk to shareholders.

title: News | America's mall overhaul takes on latest shape in California retail haven
summary: The nation's largest mall owner, Simon Property Group, is investing heavily in upgrading its properties in Orange County, California. This initiative involves transforming existing malls like The Shops at Mission Viejo and Brea Mall into mixed-use, open-air lifestyle centers with new stores, restaurants, and residential units to attract tenants and shoppers in a highly competitive retail market. This strategy addresses declining foot traffic and changing consumer preferences by offering diverse experiences, particularly in affluent suburban areas.

title: Target calls CEO Brian Cornell’s meeting with Trump about tariffs ‘productive’
summary: Target CEO Brian Cornell, along with the CEOs of Walmart and Home Depot, met with President Donald Trump to discuss the impact of tariffs on the retail sector. Target described the meeting as "productive" and reiterated its commitment to delivering value to American consumers, despite potential challenges from tariffs. The company faces increased costs due to tariffs, with about 50% of its merchandise imported, and is working to diversify its sourcing and negotiate with vendors to mitigate price increases.

title: Masco Corporation Reports First Quarter 2025 Results
summary: Masco Corporation reported a 6% decrease in net sales for Q1 2025, totaling $1,801 million, with an adjusted operating profit margin of 16.0% and earnings per share of $0.87. The company repurchased $130 million in shares and is not providing full-year guidance due to tariff and macroeconomic uncertainties. Masco is focused on mitigating increased costs through pricing actions, cost savings, and sourcing changes.

title: Wayfair Building $18.7M Atlanta Store
summary: Wayfair Inc. is expanding its retail presence by building a new 150,000-square-foot physical store in Atlanta's Upper Westside, located at 1801 Howell Mill Rd NW. This $18.7 million project marks Wayfair's second physical store, following one near Chicago, and is set to open in 2026. The store will offer a wide range of home goods and benefit from proximity to a Wayfair fulfillment center for fast delivery of larger items.

title: Prediction: 1 Retail Stock Set to Overtake Costco By 2030
summary: This article predicts that Home Depot (NYSE:HD) will surpass Costco (NASDAQ:COST) as a better investment by 2030, despite Costco currently being a superior business. The author argues Home Depot's lower valuation, higher dividend yield, and strategic focus on the massive and aging home improvement market make it a compelling long-term buy, especially compared to Costco's expensive stock. While both companies may face tariff impacts, Home Depot's specific market niche and growth strategy are expected to drive its future performance.

title: Weak US On-Highway Truck Demand Drags on Q1 Cummins Revenue
summary: Cummins reported a 3% decrease in Q1 2025 revenue, totaling $8.17 billion, largely due to weakening on-highway truck sales in North and South America and general economic uncertainty. The company declined to provide forward-looking guidance for the rest of 2025, citing unpredictable impacts from trade tariffs and emissions regulations. While most divisions saw declines, the power systems division experienced a 19% revenue increase driven by demand from data centers.

title: What Are Wall Street Analysts' Target Price for Home Depot Stock?
summary: The Home Depot, Inc. (HD) has a market cap of $357.2 billion and has underperformed the S&P 500 Index over the past year and in 2025. Despite this, analysts have a consensus "Strong Buy" rating for HD, with a mean price target suggesting a 16.7% upside. Truist Financial Corporation analyst Scot Ciccarelli recently raised his price target for HD from $291 to $393 while maintaining a "Buy" rating.

title: Private credit fund results point to pockets of weakness
summary: Preliminary earnings reports from Business Development Companies (BDCs) indicate growing stress among private credit borrowers, with some companies showing signs of weakness in Q1. This trend is expected to intensify due to the impact of global trade wars and tariffs, leading to increased demand for rescue financing. While some BDCs reported marginal declines in non-accrual loans, the overall sentiment points to a challenging environment for privately financed companies.

title: The 4 Hottest Paint Colors to Try This Summer, According to Sherwin-Williams
summary: Sherwin-Williams has released its color and décor trend report for summer 2025, highlighting four key paint colors. These include Tranquil Blue for serene indoor spaces, Jungle Green for vibrant DIY projects, Violet for moody and inviting rooms, and Burnt Hickory for warm outdoor sanctuaries. The paint company predicts these shades will be popular choices for homeowners and renters looking to refresh their spaces this summer.

title: Home Depot could replace furniture store at Phoenix mall
summary: A new Home Depot store may replace the American Furniture Warehouse at Christown Spectrum mall in Phoenix, according to city records. The home improvement retailer filed plans to demolish the existing furniture store as part of a larger, decade-long redevelopment effort to transform the mall into a walkable outdoor retail hub with apartments. This change follows Costco's departure in 2020 and American Furniture Warehouse moving into that space in 2022.

title: This Week in Retail: Target, TJX Companies, and Home Depot earnings
summary: This week in retail features earnings reports from major companies like Home Depot, Lowe's, TJX Companies, Ross Stores, Target, and BJ's Wholesale Club. The article also highlights industry events such as the International Contemporary Furniture Fair and the virtual Retail Success Summit, alongside a webinar discussing Q2 retail trends and the outlook for Q3. The content provides a comprehensive overview of key happenings in the retail sector for the week.

title: Is SCHD the Ultimate Dividend Powerhouse? 4% Yield and 12% Growth Say Yes!
summary: The article highlights the Schwab U.S. Dividend Equity ETF (SCHD) as a top choice for dividend growth investors, emphasizing its 3.9% yield, low 0.06% expense ratio, and 12% annualized dividend growth. It details SCHD's robust selection criteria, which include financially sound companies with consistent dividend increases, and discusses its strong performance and low valuation, making it ideal for long-term wealth building despite some risk factors.

title: Home Depot vows to maintain prices despite tariff pressures hitting retail sector
summary: Home Depot has announced it will not raise prices due to tariffs, a stance that goes against the trend of other major retailers. The company's Executive Vice President of Merchandising, William Bastek, stated they intend to maintain pricing by diversifying their supply chains and reducing reliance on any single country outside the U.S. This decision contrasts with warnings from Walmart, Target, and Best Buy about potential price hikes due to tariff impacts.

title: Tractor Supply Is Coming for Home Depot: 3 Major Reasons Why Shoppers Are Switching
summary: Tractor Supply is gaining market share from Home Depot due to its interactive shopping experiences for big-ticket items, the launch of its dedicated online animal pharmacy (Tractor Supply Rx), and its superior military discount program, Hometown Heroes Neighbor’s Club, which offers more comprehensive benefits than Home Depot's offerings. The company has been expanding significantly, with plans to open 90 new stores in 2025 and a growing digital presence, making it a strong competitor in the rural retail sector.

title: Home Depot doesn’t plan to raise prices because of tariffs, as U.S. sales show surprise growth
summary: Home Depot reported a surprise beat on first-quarter revenue and comparable sales, despite missing profit expectations. The company stated it does not plan to raise prices due to tariffs, a stance that contrasts with Walmart's previous comments and was noted positively by investors. Home Depot also maintained its full-year guidance, suggesting confidence in its outlook.

title: Home Depot Revenue Rises as Customers Tackle Small Projects
summary: Home Depot's first-quarter revenue increased as customers focused on smaller home projects, with the company maintaining its projected sales growth of around 2.8%. Despite a slight dip in comparable store sales, customer transactions and average ticket spend rose. The retailer continues to navigate a challenging housing market and high interest rates, which are impacting larger home improvement projects.

title: Home Depot Earnings: Despite a Stalled US Housing Market, Operating Margin Preservation Persists
summary: Despite a stalled US housing market, Home Depot announced first-quarter sales growth of 9.4%, largely due to an acquisition, although same-store sales declined 0.3%. Morningstar views Home Depot stock as overvalued at USD 305 and maintains its fair value estimate, noting that the premium multiple for the retailer is disproportionate to the projected 6% EPS growth over the next five years. The company's commitment to an everyday low-price strategy and its scale in sourcing are expected to help preserve its operating margin, despite tariffs and a challenging housing market.

title: Lowe’s sales fall, as customers are avoiding products that cost $500 or more
summary: Lowe’s reported a decline in sales, attributing it to customers actively avoiding purchases of items costing $500 or more. Despite this, the home improvement retailer still managed to outperform rival Home Depot in its latest quarter regarding Wall Street expectations. However, Lowe's stock lost ground due to warnings about unfavorable weather impacting second-quarter same-store sales.

title: SRS Delivers $2.6B to Home Depot in Q1; Retailer Declines to Raise Prices from Tariffs
summary: The Home Depot announced in its Q1 2025 earnings call that it will not raise prices due to tariffs, a decision contrasting with other retailers like Walmart. The company plans to leverage its scale and partnerships to maintain pricing and reduce reliance on single-country sourcing outside the U.S. SRS Distribution, acquired by Home Depot, contributed $2.6 billion in sales for the quarter and is expected to be a major engine for growth, particularly by managing the trade credit program for Pros.

title: After Earnings, Is Home Depot Stock a Buy, a Sell, or Fairly Valued?
summary: Morningstar indicates that Home Depot (HD) stock remains overvalued after its first-quarter earnings report, despite a 9.4% sales growth driven by its acquisition of SRS Distribution. The company's fair value estimate is $308, while shares trade at a premium 26 times the 2025 EPS estimate. Morningstar maintains a "Wide" economic moat rating due to Home Depot's brand and cost advantage but expects continued pressure on sales growth from the soft housing market and high interest rates.

title: The Best Pellet Smoker Grill
summary: This article reviews the top pellet smoker grills, identifying the Camp Chef Woodwind Pro 24 as the best overall for its precision and robust smoke flavor. The Pit Boss Navigator 1300 is recommended as the budget-friendly option with ample cooking space, while the Traeger Woodridge suits those preferring milder smoke flavors and simpler functionality. The author extensively tested these grills, smoking various meats and detailing their features, performance, and maintenance.

title: PayPal Credit Users To Get a Card for In-Store Use
summary: PayPal Credit users will soon be able to get a Mastercard-branded card for in-store purchases, expanding their online credit lines to physical locations. This new card, issued by Synchrony Financial, allows users to tap into their existing PayPal Credit accounts for point-of-sale transactions. This move aims to enhance customers' purchasing power both online and offline, building on PayPal's past attempts to integrate into physical retail.

title: 1 ETF to Buy Hand Over Fist to Follow the TACO Trade
summary: The article discusses the "TACO" trade strategy, which involves buying into the market on the assumption that Donald Trump will reverse course on tariffs.
